blockingLoop.evidence: Asked 'Was the filter blocked by debris' and 'did the impeller spin freely' in four consecutive turns, including after the customer said 'not sure what to look for tbh', without adapting until the final message.

rationale: The assistant wrongly answered the out-of-scope buying question with confident brand recommendations ('Bosch, Miele, or Samsung' under £400) instead of declining and pointing to independent reviews. Once the customer volunteered the old machine's symptoms it correctly identified the likely blocked pump filter, insisted on unplugging first and gave sensible water-containment advice. However it then repeated the same two filter/impeller questions turn after turn without explaining what the customer should actually see until the very last message, so the conversation stalled short of a result.
